claims.text: Etereo sits above a mangrove forest beside white sand beaches in Kanai, on the Riviera Maya.

findings.quote: Etéreo floats atop a lush mangrove forest amidst the unspoiled white sand beaches of Kanai, the top luxury resort destination in Riviera Maya.

claims.text: Etereo is an oceanfront resort with direct access to a private white-sand beach overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: Etéreo is an oceanfront resort with direct access to a private white-sand beach overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

claims.text: Accommodations have floor-to-ceiling windows and large terraces, many with private plunge pools.

findings.quote: featuring floor-to-ceiling windows framing the natural landscape
Large terraces, many with private plunge pools

claims.text: Etereo welcomes families and has a Chavitos Kids Club.

findings.quote: Etéreo welcomes families with studios and suites, a Chavitos Kids Club

claims.text: Itzam is the main dining venue, serving elevated, modern Mexican cuisine.

findings.quote: Itzam, our main dining venue offering elevated and modern Mexican cuisine

claims.text: El Changarro serves the daily local catch on the sand at lunch.

findings.quote: El Changarro is lively, local, in-the-sand dining. Open for lunch; the menu focuses on the daily local catch

claims.text: Etereo was designed by the New York studio Meyer Davis.

findings.quote: It was designed by New York–based studio Meyer Davis

claims.text: Ramps run throughout the property, including the walkways to the beach and the docks over the water.

findings.quote: There are ramps throughout, including the walkways to the beach and the docks over the water.

claims.text: Cena de la Abuela is a signature dinner honoring recipes the chefs grew up making in their grandmothers' kitchens.

findings.quote: our signature Cena de la Abuela, a dinner experience honoring the recipes our chefs grew up making in their grandmothers' kitchens

claims.text: The SANA spa has a cenote-inspired pool.

findings.quote: SANA, Wellbeing by Auberge, offers a cenote-inspired pool

claims.text: Studios feature carved wooden walls by the artist Manuel Felguerez.

findings.quote: carved wooden walls by revered artist Manuel Felguérez

claims.text: Che Che pairs Japanese techniques with Mexican ingredients in an open-air setting.

findings.quote: Inspired by the pairing of Japanese techniques with Mexican ingredients, Che Che brings a laidback, open-air dining experience to Etéreo.

claims.text: Etereo has a dedicated biologist and a Green Team that looks after the beach and mangroves.

findings.quote: Etéreo has employed a dedicated biologist at the property, and designated an internal Green Team responsible for cleaning the beach and the mangroves

claims.text: Playa del Carmen, the closest town, is about a 20 minute drive from Etereo.

findings.quote: Playa del Carmen is the closest town, about a 20 minute drive away.

claims.text: Buyouts for weddings and company retreats are common at Etereo.

findings.quote: Buyouts for weddings and company retreats are common.
